# Protagnst

> Protagnst is a global B2B sales outsourcing, consultancy, and training firm specializing in lead generation, outbound prospecting, and sales strategy for diverse industries.

Protagnst serves as a comprehensive partner for B2B companies seeking to scale their sales operations through outsourced SDR/BDR teams, strategic consulting, and customized sales playbooks. The firm operates across multiple regions including Latin America, USA, Europe, and Asia, with expertise in leveraging AI and CRM tools for customer acquisition.

## Key Topics

- B2B Sales Consulting
- Lead Generation
- Outbound Prospecting
- Sales Outsourcing

- Ideal Customer Profile

- Latin America

## Core Services

- [Our Services](https://protagnst.com/our-services): Protagnst services: outbound prospecting, sales playbook, marketing strategy.
- [B2B Sales Prospecting Services](https://protagnst.com/b2b-sales-prospecting-services): B2B prospecting service for meetings with decision makers.
- [B2B Sales Consultancy Firm](https://protagnst.com/b2b-sales-consultancy): B2B sales consulting for commercial problems and lead generation.
- [Sales Playbook](https://protagnst.com/sales-playbook-2): Sales playbook for structuring commercial process and lead qualification.
- [Marketing Strategy](https://protagnst.com/marketing-strategy-2): Marketing strategy service for company positioning and customer acquisition.
